name: Sugimoto Jurina
source: Tsuyoshi's cousin and [url=/c22269]Ruriho's[/url] younger sister. She is always cosplaying a character called "Magical Girl Milk". She spends her time playing with her friends due to her mother and older sister always working.
translation: 刚的表妹，也是[url=/c22269]瑠璃穗[/url]的妹妹。她总是扮演“魔法少女米露”这个角色。由于母亲和姐姐总在工作，她便和朋友们一起玩耍度日。
